description: This file defines the InvokeCommandRegistry object which manages command and capability specifications for nodes in an Android application related to OpenClaw. It includes data classes for node flags, capabilities, and commands, as well as functions to retrieve commands/capabilities based on runtime flags and to find commands by name.

classes.name: NodeRuntimeFlags
classes.description: Holds boolean flags indicating the runtime capabilities and status of the node.

classes.name: InvokeCommandAvailability
classes.description: Enum specifying the availability conditions for commands.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityAvailability
classes.description: Enum specifying the availability conditions for node capabilities.

classes.name: NodeCapabilitySpec
classes.description: Defines a node capability with a name and its availability.

classes.name: InvokeCommandSpec
classes.description: Defines a command with name, foreground requirement, and availability.

classes.name: InvokeCommandRegistry
classes.description: Singleton object that maintains command and capability registries, and provides utility functions.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a command specification by its name.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a list of capability names that are advertised based on the node's runtime flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of command names that are available based on the node's runtime flags.
